meta.name: add-macos-statusbar
meta.description: Add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw. Shows a bolt icon with a green/red dot indicating whether NanoClaw is running, with Start, Stop, and Restart controls. macOS only.

copy.tagline: 在菜单栏显示 NanoClaw 运行状态并控制启停
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 macOS 菜单栏快速查看和切换 NanoClaw 运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Show NanoClaw status and controls in macOS menu bar
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly check and toggle NanoClaw from the macOS menu bar

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在 macOS 菜单栏添加一个闪电图标,用绿/红点显示 NanoClaw 是否在运行,并提供开始、停止、重启和查看日志的控制。
howto.when: 在 macOS 上,当你要求添加菜单栏状态指示器或运行 /add-macos-statusbar 时触发。需要已安装 Xcode Command Line Tools(swiftc)。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 添加一个菜单栏状态图标
say.note: 菜单栏会出现闪电图标,显示运行状态

say.text: 帮我安装 macOS 状态栏指示器并启动服务
say.note: 编译并加载服务,图标自动出现

say.text: 为 NanoClaw 加上开始、停止和重启的菜单栏控制

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude adds a bolt icon to the macOS menu bar showing NanoClaw's running status with a green/red dot, and provides Start, Stop, Restart, and View Logs controls.
howto.when_en: Triggered on macOS when you ask to add a menu bar status indicator or run /add-macos-statusbar. Requires Xcode Command Line Tools (swiftc).

say_en.text: Add a menu bar status icon for NanoClaw
say_en.note: A bolt icon appears showing running status

say_en.text: Install the macOS status bar indicator and start the service
say_en.note: Compiles and loads the service; icon appears

say_en.text: Add Start, Stop, and Restart controls for NanoClaw to the menu bar
say_en.note: Click the icon to control the service
